exactSourceStatements: Inscribed in 2021 (16.COM) on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity
Al-naoor is a wooden wheel that rotates on its axis.
It is used on the streams of the Euphrates River in Iraq, where water levels are lower than the adjacent fields.
The wheel is made of twenty-four columns of wooden sticks and twenty-four clay jugs attached to the outer circumference with palm leaf ropes
the wheel is installed vertically between two stone pedestals on the streams of the river
